events.body:

Segment F4 is settled by the trace: the LTA DataMall accident reported 13:52 on Orchard Road (towards Bras Basah) after Cavenagh Road, 0 m from the optimal route, is within 300 m of the replaced stretch and predates the segment, corroborated by Orchard Road speed band 1 (0–9 km/h) at 14:00–14:10 — RD-4(a)/(b) exempt it [F18][F15][F4][RD-4]. Its 1.85 km is therefore not refundable.

Segment F5 fails RD-4: no qualifying incident lies on the replaced stretch, and the only congestion record is on Orchard Road, whose band-1 window ends at 14:10; Bras Basah Road ran at band 4 (30–39 km/h) and Bayfront Avenue at band 3, weather fair [F18][F15][F16][F17][F19][F5][RD-4]. On consent, the rider's 14:02 "Sure" answered a proposal naming Cavenagh Road only; the driver's own post-trip statement places the stop at "the 7-Eleven I know on Beach Road" — a location the driver chose, away from the agreed road, and a driver's statement is not rider consent [F10][F11][F12][F14][F5][RD-5].

F5 therefore counts, and its 2.87 km is refundable [F5][RD-2].

Amount: the trace gives the rate as the fare record's distance fare ÷ distance km: $13.55 ÷ 9.61 km = $1.4100/km [F6][F9]; 2.87 km × $1.4100/km = $4.0467 → $4.05 [F5][F6][RD-2]. The driver's own pre-trip ask named only Cavenagh Road ('ok if I go round by Cavenagh?', F10) and the rider's 'Sure' (F11) can only reach that named road; no fact places either off-route segment on Cavenagh Road — nothing in F2/F4/F5 or any chat message ties the driven segments to it.

The rider's request was only for 'a 7-Eleven on the way' (F11), and the driver chose the outlet himself ('the 7-Eleven I know on Beach Road', F14, a post-trip statement and not consent under G11); the car stood 4 min 10 s at a point 2995 m from pickup and 2098 m from drop-off (F2), which is not 'on the way' on a 3.9 km optimal route (F1).

Segment F5 (14:17–14:29) cannot be excused by the rider's 'Sure' at 14:02 (F11) even if read as general consent, because it is a detour that reaches no destination of the rider's and contains a stationary 4 min 10 s stop the driver picked himself, plus the driver's route is at its furthest 1553 m off the optimal route (F5).

The only traffic record on the optimal route is a 13:52 accident on Orchard Road towards Bras Basah after Cavenagh Road with two lanes closed (F18), corroborated by Orchard Road speed band 1 (0–9 km/h) at 14:00–14:10 (F15); that justifies leaving Orchard Road, not the 1.55 km diversion off the corridor to Beach Road (F5).

No traffic fact supports driving along Beach Road: Bras Basah Road ran at speed band 4 (30–39 km/h) at 14:00–14:35 (F16) and Bayfront Avenue at band 3 (F17), and weather was fair (F19), so the second segment fails the RD-4 reasonableness test.

The waiting fee of $1.08 for 4.2 min (F7) corresponds to the 4 min 10 s stationary period in segment F5 (F2); under RD-3(c) metered waiting is chargeable on RydeTAXI, so the rider seeks no refund of it, only the mileage above.
